# PlotNeuralNet drawing primitives

Vendored from [HarisIqbal88/PlotNeuralNet](https://github.com/HarisIqbal88/PlotNeuralNet),
`master` snapshot retrieved on November 16, 2026. This is the actual upstream
Python/TikZ implementation used by `figures/generate_plotneuralnet.py`.
Only line endings and trailing whitespace were normalized. The MIT notice
is retained in [LICENSE](LICENSE). These files are drawing tools and are
not used by the possession-inference package.

Upstream source archive SHA256: `7a33b82515924565df154ed95f1066865aa620c65e0ac3ea75e9bb57650a58cc`.
